observations: LG brand logo and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg' text are visible on the top left of the control panel (photo 0).
The control panel features a rotary dial and several push buttons.
A green 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' sticker is present on the left side of the door (photo 0).
A '10 YEAR MOTOR WARRANTY' sticker is visible on the right side of the door (photo 0).
The exterior casing shows significant surface rust and heavy dirt, particularly around the base and lower door frame.
The interior drum is visible through the glass door and appears clean.
The control panel appears to be in good physical condition.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: The exterior condition and the presence of rust contradict the 'barely used' and 'new' claims.

risks.proof: A photo of the drum interior after the door is open.

risks.proof: A video showing the buttons being pressed and the display reacting.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and running a cycle.
Photo of the interior drum to check for rust or damage.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
